release_name: EOS Control Plane - P3 Milestone Closure Baseline

milestones_closed_in_p3.title: Mission CLI & Compact Cursor Mission Package Generator
milestones_closed_in_p3.claim: EOS can receive a mission, create its local directory structure, formulate task contracts, and package instructions for Cursor.

milestones_closed_in_p3.title: Cursor Return Adapter & Ingestion Engine
milestones_closed_in_p3.claim: EOS can ingest and validate return packages from Cursor, enforce scope boundaries, and detect secret leaks and test failures.

milestones_closed_in_p3.title: Role & Skill Registry Runtime
milestones_closed_in_p3.claim: EOS can register, evaluate, and select agent roles and skills in a governed, traceable manner with independent reviewers (author != reviewer).

milestones_closed_in_p3.title: Supervision & Multi-Agent Correction Loop
milestones_closed_in_p3.claim: EOS can supervise delegated tasks across 8 quality dimensions, issue structured correction directives, and escalate unresolvable defects to HITL.

milestones_closed_in_p3.title: Bounded Worktree Mutation Canary
milestones_closed_in_p3.claim: EOS can coordinate a limited local code mutation inside an isolated worktree under contractual scope, tests, evidence, and mathematical rollback (Δ = 0).

milestones_closed_in_p3.title: Ledger Crash Recovery, Concurrency & Operational Persistence
milestones_closed_in_p3.claim: EOS can persist, lock, and verify ledger events across concurrent local agent operations, recover from trailing write crashes, and fail closed upon tampering.

milestones_closed_in_p3.title: Operator Manuals, Packaging & Formal P3 Baseline Closure
milestones_closed_in_p3.claim: EOS provides complete, standalone operator manuals and reproducible release packaging for local mission orchestration.
